data.name: Dark Dreams on Diverging Roads
data.detailed_description:
Who are you?

You are a famous author embarking on a global book tour to promote your latest release.

During this tour your will:

  • Drive in an old beat up car with no GPS and a malfunctioning radio

  • Travel through unique locations resembling a pop up book

  • Plan your coffee shop visits to make sure you don’t run out of fuel

  • Encounter interesting characters (and unexpected passengers) during interactive visual novel segments

Will you be able to make it through your book tour in one piece? Or will you find yourself succumbing to what lurks in your back seat...?

Meet the dev team

Kotiya is comprised of two developers:

  • Atiya Nova is a professional game developer who previously released “You’re Not Family”. She’s handling the code, narrative, 3D models, UI, game design, and sound design.

  • Kodey Owen is a pen and ink artist who will be contributing hand drawn illustrations and helping with the editing, QA, game design, and sound design.

data.short_description: Drive through the world as a famous author in this upcoming free narrative game. Manage your fuel (coffee) and figure out how to navigate with no GPS and a broken radio. Meet a host of interesting characters and don’t forget to LOOK BEHIND YOU.
